<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Criar Incidente - Indisponibilidade de Aplicação/Sistema">66309e07c3189f54e079b13ed401314a</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:4b30de07c3189f54e079b13ed4013197</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Técnico - Outages - technical_multip</name><order>100</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control,oldValue,newValue,isLoading){if(isLoading)return;renderTechnicalOutages();}
function renderTechnicalOutages(){
 var multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.setDisplay('lab_technical_services',!multi);
 g_form.setDisplay('report_service',!multi);g_form.setDisplay('report_offering',!multi);
 if(multi){if(g_form.getValue('report_service')){g_form.clearValue('report_service');}if(g_form.getValue('report_offering')){g_form.clearValue('report_offering');}}
 g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service',false);g_form.setValue('outage_status_data','');
 g_form.hideFieldMsg('technical_multiple',true);
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application');if(!app){return;}
 var others=g_form.getValue('technical_additional'),service=g_form.getValue('report_service'),offering=g_form.getValue('report_offering');
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getStatus');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 ga.addParam('sysparm_multiple',multi?'yes':'no');ga.addParam('sysparm_additional',others);ga.addParam('sysparm_service',service);ga.addParam('sysparm_offering',offering);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('technical_additional')!==others||g_form.getValue('report_service')!==service||g_form.getValue('report_offering')!==offering||(g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes')!==multi){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_multiple','Consulta de ocorrências indisponível. Será refeita no envio.','info',false);return;}
  if(r.count){g_form.setValue('outage_status_data',JSON.stringify(r));g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service',true);}
  else{g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_multiple',r.message,'info',false);}
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>01409647c3189f54e079b13ed401315f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Outages - technical_multip</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_01409647c3189f54e079b13ed401315f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Técnico - Serviços - iniciar</name><order>100</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad(){g_form.setMandatory('report_service',false);g_form.setMandatory('report_offering',false);resetRelatedServices();}
function loadRelatedServices(name,method,serviceId){
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application'),multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.hideFieldMsg(name,true);g_form.clearOptions(name);g_form.addOption(name,'','-- Não informado --');g_form.setReadOnly(name,true);
 if(!app||multi||(name==='report_offering'&&!serviceId)){
  if(!app&&name==='report_service'){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,'Selecione a aplicação para consultar os serviços relacionados.','info',false);}
  return;
 }
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name',method);ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 if(serviceId){ga.addParam('sysparm_service',serviceId);}
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes'||(name==='report_offering'&&g_form.getValue('report_service')!==serviceId)){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,'Não foi possível consultar os vínculos. Recarregue o formulário para tentar novamente.','error',false);return;}
  g_form.clearOptions(name);g_form.addOption(name,'','-- Não informado --');
  for(var i=0;i<r.options.length;i++){g_form.addOption(name,r.options[i].value,r.options[i].label);}
  g_form.setReadOnly(name,!r.options.length);
  if(!r.options.length){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,name==='report_service'?'Nenhum serviço operacional com oferta diretamente relacionada à aplicação selecionada. O preenchimento continua opcional.':'Nenhuma oferta operacional deste serviço está diretamente relacionada à aplicação selecionada.','info',false);}
 });
}
function resetRelatedServices(){
 g_form.clearValue('report_offering');g_form.clearValue('report_service');
 loadRelatedServices('report_offering','getOfferings','');loadRelatedServices('report_service','getServices','');
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>05409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013126</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Serviços - iniciar</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_05409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013126</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 14:25:14</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Serviço e oferta (opcional)">fa309e07c3189f54e079b13ed40131e5</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:087b94bbc3185f94e079b13ed4013197</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field>offering_unknown</field><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Negócio - offering_unknown</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) { if (isLoading) { return; } if (/^(true|1|yes)$/i.test(newValue)) { g_form.clearValue('report_offering'); } renderBusinessIntake(true); }
function renderBusinessIntake(checkOutages) {
    function yes(name) { return /^(true|1|yes)$/i.test(g_form.getValue(name)); }
    function field(name, visible, mandatory) {
        g_form.setMandatory(name, false);
        g_form.setDisplay(name, visible);
        g_form.setMandatory(name, visible && mandatory);
    }
    var serviceId = g_form.getValue('report_service');
    var offeringId = g_form.getValue('report_offering');
    var unknown = yes('offering_unknown');
    g_form.setMandatory('report_offering', false);
    g_form.setReadOnly('report_offering', !serviceId || unknown);
    g_form.setMandatory('report_offering', !!serviceId && !unknown);
    field('affected_function', g_form.getValue('report_extent') === 'partial', true);
    field('slow_action', g_form.getValue('report_symptom') === 'slow', true);
    field('report_frequency', /^(slow|error)$/.test(g_form.getValue('report_symptom')), true);
    field('error_message', g_form.getValue('report_symptom') === 'error', false);
    field('workaround_detail', g_form.getValue('report_continuity') === 'workaround', false);
    field('report_started_at', !yes('started_unknown'), true);
    field('classification_note', g_form.getValue('report_extent') === 'total' &&
        g_form.getValue('report_scope') === 'all' && g_form.getValue('report_continuity') === 'normal', true);
    if (!g_form.getValue('outage_status_data')) {
        g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service', false);
        g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_offering', false);
    }
    if (!checkOutages) { return; }
    g_form.setValue('outage_status_data', '');
    g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service', false);
    g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_offering', false);
    g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_service', true);
    g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_offering', true);
    if (!serviceId) { return; }
    // Sem oferta selecionada ainda, consulta somente o servico pai.
    var queryUnknown = unknown || !offeringId;
    var target = offeringId && !unknown ? 'report_offering' : 'report_service';
    g_form.showFieldMsg(target, 'Consultando ocorrências em curso...', 'info', false);
    var ga = new GlideAjax('LabBusinessIncidentAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getStatus');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_service', serviceId);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_offering', offeringId);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_unknown', queryUnknown ? 'true' : 'false');
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        if (g_form.getValue('report_service') !== serviceId || g_form.getValue('report_offering') !== offeringId || yes('offering_unknown') !== unknown) { return; }
        g_form.hideFieldMsg(target, true);
        var result;
        try { result = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) { result = null; }
        if (!result || !result.ok) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(target, 'Não foi possível consultar as ocorrências agora. A consulta será refeita no envio. ' +
                (result && result.message ? result.message : ''), 'info', false);
            return;
        }
        if (result.count) {
            g_form.setValue('outage_status_data', JSON.stringify(result));
            g_form.setDisplay(target === 'report_offering' ? 'outage_notice_offering' : 'outage_notice_service', true);
        } else {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(target, result.message, 'info', false);
        }
    });
}

function loadBusinessOptions(name, method, serviceId) {
    var previous = g_form.getValue(name);
    g_form.clearOptions(name);
    g_form.addOption(name, '', 'Carregando...');
    var ga = new GlideAjax('LabBusinessIncidentAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', method);
    if (serviceId) { ga.addParam('sysparm_service', serviceId); }
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        if (name === 'report_offering' && g_form.getValue('report_service') !== serviceId) { return; }
        var result;
        try { result = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) { result = null; }
        g_form.clearOptions(name);
        g_form.addOption(name, '', '-- Selecione --');
        if (!result || !result.ok) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(name, 'Não foi possível carregar as opções. Recarregue o formulário para tentar novamente.', 'error', false);
            return;
        }
        var validPrevious = false;
        for (var i = 0; i < result.options.length; i++) {
            g_form.addOption(name, result.options[i].value, result.options[i].label);
            if (result.options[i].value === previous) { validPrevious = true; }
        }
        if (validPrevious) { g_form.setValue(name, previous); }
        if (name === 'report_service' && g_form.getValue('report_service')) {
            loadBusinessOptions('report_offering', 'getOfferings', g_form.getValue('report_service'));
        }
        if (name === 'report_offering' && !result.options.length) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(name, 'Não há ofertas operacionais cadastradas para este serviço. Marque Não sei identificar a oferta para continuar.', 'info', false);
        }
        renderBusinessIntake(true);
    });
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-08 13:16:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>287b18bbc3185f94e079b13ed4013138</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Negócio - offering_unknown</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_287b18bbc3185f94e079b13ed4013138</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-08 13:16:16</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Serviços de negócio e ofertas">b66b10bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131c6</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Criar Incidente - Indisponibilidade de Aplicação/Sistema">66309e07c3189f54e079b13ed401314a</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:7f305247c3189f54e079b13ed4013196</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Técnico - Auto outage extensão</name><order>110</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control,oldValue,newValue,isLoading){if(isLoading)return;refreshAutoOutage();}
function showAutoOutage(visible){
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_outage_begin',false);
 var fields=['technical_outage_notice','technical_outage_type','technical_outage_begin','technical_outage_hint'];
 for(var i=0;i<fields.length;i++){g_form.setDisplay(fields[i],visible);}
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_outage_begin',visible);
}
function refreshAutoOutage(){
 showAutoOutage(false);g_form.setValue('technical_outage_requested','false');g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','not_applicable');
 g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_extent',true);
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application'),extent=g_form.getValue('report_extent');
 if(!app||(extent!=='total'&&extent!=='partial')){return;}
 g_form.setValue('technical_outage_type',extent==='total'?'outage':'degradation');
 g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','checking');
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getAutoOutageState');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('report_extent')!==extent){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','error');g_form.showFieldMsg('report_extent','Não foi possível verificar os outages da aplicação. Recarregue o formulário antes de enviar.','error',false);return;}
  if(r.hasExisting){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','existing');g_form.showFieldMsg('report_extent','Já existe outage ou degradação em curso para o SI principal. Nenhum novo outage será criado.','info',false);return;}
  if(!g_form.getValue('technical_outage_begin')){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_begin',r.now);}
  g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','eligible');g_form.setValue('technical_outage_requested','true');showAutoOutage(true);
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 15:16:35</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>2fc3a287c310df54e079b13ed401316e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Auto outage extensão</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_2fc3a287c310df54e079b13ed401316e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 15:16:35</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Compartilhado - Caracterização - ini</name><order>100</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad(){renderCharacteristics();}
function renderCharacteristics(){
 function yes(n){return /^(true|1|yes)$/i.test(g_form.getValue(n));}
 function field(n,v,m){g_form.setMandatory(n,false);g_form.setDisplay(n,v);g_form.setMandatory(n,v&&m);}
 field('affected_function',g_form.getValue('report_extent')==='partial',true);
 field('slow_action',g_form.getValue('report_symptom')==='slow',true);
 field('report_frequency',/^(slow|error)$/.test(g_form.getValue('report_symptom')),true);
 field('error_message',g_form.getValue('report_symptom')==='error',false);
 field('workaround_detail',g_form.getValue('report_continuity')==='workaround',false);
 field('report_started_at',!yes('started_unknown'),true);

function loadRelatedServices(name,method,serviceId){
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application'),multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.hideFieldMsg(name,true);g_form.clearOptions(name);g_form.addOption(name,'','-- Não informado --');g_form.setReadOnly(name,true);
 if(!app||multi||(name==='report_offering'&&!serviceId)){
  if(!app&&name==='report_service'){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,'Selecione a aplicação para consultar os serviços relacionados.','info',false);}
  return;
 }
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name',method);ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 if(serviceId){ga.addParam('sysparm_service',serviceId);}
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes'||(name==='report_offering'&&g_form.getValue('report_service')!==serviceId)){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,'Não foi possível consultar os vínculos. Recarregue o formulário para tentar novamente.','error',false);return;}
  g_form.clearOptions(name);g_form.addOption(name,'','-- Não informado --');
  for(var i=0;i<r.options.length;i++){g_form.addOption(name,r.options[i].value,r.options[i].label);}
  g_form.setReadOnly(name,!r.options.length);

O preenchimento continua opcional.':'Nenhuma oferta operacional deste serviço está diretamente relacionada à aplicação selecionada.','info',false);}
 });
}
function resetRelatedServices(){
 g_form.clearValue('report_offering');g_form.clearValue('report_service');
 loadRelatedServices('report_offering','getOfferings','');loadRelatedServices('report_service','getServices','');
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>45409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013133</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Serviços - dependência da </sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_45409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013133</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 14:25:15</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Serviço e oferta (opcional)">fa309e07c3189f54e079b13ed40131e5</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:cc7bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed401314c</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field>report_service</field><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Negócio - report_service</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) { if (isLoading) { return; } g_form.clearValue('report_offering'); g_form.clearOptions('report_offering'); g_form.addOption('report_offering', '', '-- Selecione --'); if (newValue) { loadBusinessOptions('report_offering', 'getOfferings', newValue); } renderBusinessIntake(true); }
function renderBusinessIntake(checkOutages) {
    function yes(name) { return /^(true|1|yes)$/i.test(g_form.getValue(name)); }
    function field(name, visible, mandatory) {
        g_form.setMandatory(name, false);
        g_form.setDisplay(name, visible);
        g_form.setMandatory(name, visible && mandatory);
    }
    var serviceId = g_form.getValue('report_service');
    var offeringId = g_form.getValue('report_offering');
    var unknown = yes('offering_unknown');
    g_form.setMandatory('report_offering', false);
    g_form.setReadOnly('report_offering', !serviceId || unknown);
    g_form.setMandatory('report_offering', !!serviceId && !unknown);
    field('affected_function', g_form.getValue('report_extent') === 'partial', true);
    field('slow_action', g_form.getValue('report_symptom') === 'slow', true);
    field('report_frequency', /^(slow|error)$/.test(g_form.getValue('report_symptom')), true);
    field('error_message', g_form.getValue('report_symptom') === 'error', false);
    field('workaround_detail', g_form.getValue('report_continuity') === 'workaround', false);
    field('report_started_at', !yes('started_unknown'), true);
    field('classification_note', g_form.getValue('report_extent') === 'total' &&
        g_form.getValue('report_scope') === 'all' && g_form.getValue('report_continuity') === 'normal', true);
    if (!g_form.getValue('outage_status_data')) {
        g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service', false);
        g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_offering', false);
    }
    if (!checkOutages) { return; }
    g_form.setValue('outage_status_data', '');
    g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service', false);
    g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_offering', false);
    g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_service', true);
    g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_offering', true);
    if (!serviceId) { return; }
    // Sem oferta selecionada ainda, consulta somente o servico pai.
    var queryUnknown = unknown || !offeringId;
    var target = offeringId && !unknown ? 'report_offering' : 'report_service';
    g_form.showFieldMsg(target, 'Consultando ocorrências em curso...', 'info', false);
    var ga = new GlideAjax('LabBusinessIncidentAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getStatus');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_service', serviceId);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_offering', offeringId);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_unknown', queryUnknown ? 'true' : 'false');
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        if (g_form.getValue('report_service') !== serviceId || g_form.getValue('report_offering') !== offeringId || yes('offering_unknown') !== unknown) { return; }
        g_form.hideFieldMsg(target, true);
        var result;
        try { result = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) { result = null; }
        if (!result || !result.ok) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(target, 'Não foi possível consultar as ocorrências agora. A consulta será refeita no envio. ' +
                (result && result.message ? result.message : ''), 'info', false);
            return;
        }
        if (result.count) {
            g_form.setValue('outage_status_data', JSON.stringify(result));
            g_form.setDisplay(target === 'report_offering' ? 'outage_notice_offering' : 'outage_notice_service', true);
        } else {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(target, result.message, 'info', false);
        }
    });
}

function loadBusinessOptions(name, method, serviceId) {
    var previous = g_form.getValue(name);
    g_form.clearOptions(name);
    g_form.addOption(name, '', 'Carregando...');
    var ga = new GlideAjax('LabBusinessIncidentAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', method);
    if (serviceId) { ga.addParam('sysparm_service', serviceId); }
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        if (name === 'report_offering' && g_form.getValue('report_service') !== serviceId) { return; }
        var result;
        try { result = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) { result = null; }
        g_form.clearOptions(name);
        g_form.addOption(name, '', '-- Selecione --');
        if (!result || !result.ok) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(name, 'Não foi possível carregar as opções. Recarregue o formulário para tentar novamente.', 'error', false);
            return;
        }
        var validPrevious = false;
        for (var i = 0; i < result.options.length; i++) {
            g_form.addOption(name, result.options[i].value, result.options[i].label);
            if (result.options[i].value === previous) { validPrevious = true; }
        }
        if (validPrevious) { g_form.setValue(name, previous); }
        if (name === 'report_service' && g_form.getValue('report_service')) {
            loadBusinessOptions('report_offering', 'getOfferings', g_form.getValue('report_service'));
        }
        if (name === 'report_offering' && !result.options.length) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(name, 'Não há ofertas operacionais cadastradas para este serviço. Marque Não sei identificar a oferta para continuar.', 'info', false);
        }
        renderBusinessIntake(true);
    });
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-08 13:16:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>687bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131f5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Negócio - report_service</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_687bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131f5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-08 13:16:16</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Serviços de negócio e ofertas">b66b10bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131c6</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

function showAutoOutage(visible){
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_outage_begin',false);
 var fields=['technical_outage_notice','technical_outage_type','technical_outage_begin','technical_outage_hint'];
 for(var i=0;i<fields.length;i++){g_form.setDisplay(fields[i],visible);}
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_outage_begin',visible);
}
function refreshAutoOutage(){
 showAutoOutage(false);g_form.setValue('technical_outage_requested','false');g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','not_applicable');
 g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_extent',true);
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application'),extent=g_form.getValue('report_extent');
 if(!app||(extent!=='total'&&extent!=='partial')){return;}
 g_form.setValue('technical_outage_type',extent==='total'?'outage':'degradation');
 g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','checking');
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getAutoOutageState');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('report_extent')!==extent){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','error');g_form.showFieldMsg('report_extent','Não foi possível verificar os outages da aplicação. Recarregue o formulário antes de enviar.','error',false);return;}
  if(r.hasExisting){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','existing');g_form.showFieldMsg('report_extent','Já existe outage ou degradação em curso para o SI principal. Nenhum novo outage será criado.','info',false);return;}
  if(!g_form.getValue('technical_outage_begin')){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_begin',r.now);}
  g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','eligible');g_form.setValue('technical_outage_requested','true');showAutoOutage(true);
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 15:16:35</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>6bc3a287c310df54e079b13ed4013144</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Auto outage iniciar</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_6bc3a287c310df54e079b13ed4013144</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 15:16:35</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

function renderTechnicalOutages(){
 var multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.setDisplay('lab_technical_services',!multi);
 g_form.setDisplay('report_service',!multi);g_form.setDisplay('report_offering',!multi);
 if(multi){if(g_form.getValue('report_service')){g_form.clearValue('report_service');}if(g_form.getValue('report_offering')){g_form.clearValue('report_offering');}}
 g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service',false);g_form.setValue('outage_status_data','');
 g_form.hideFieldMsg('technical_multiple',true);
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application');if(!app){return;}
 var others=g_form.getValue('technical_additional'),service=g_form.getValue('report_service'),offering=g_form.getValue('report_offering');
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getStatus');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 ga.addParam('sysparm_multiple',multi?'yes':'no');ga.addParam('sysparm_additional',others);ga.addParam('sysparm_service',service);ga.addParam('sysparm_offering',offering);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('technical_additional')!==others||g_form.getValue('report_service')!==service||g_form.getValue('report_offering')!==offering||(g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes')!==multi){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_multiple','Consulta de ocorrências indisponível. Será refeita no envio.','info',false);return;}
  if(r.count){g_form.setValue('outage_status_data',JSON.stringify(r));g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service',true);}
  else{g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_multiple',r.message,'info',false);}
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>89409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013140</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Outages - iniciar</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_89409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013140</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

function renderApplications(){
 var multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_additional',false);g_form.setDisplay('technical_additional',multi);g_form.setMandatory('technical_additional',multi);
 if(!multi&&g_form.getValue('technical_additional')){g_form.clearValue('technical_additional');}
 var id=g_form.getValue('technical_application');
 if(!id){g_form.setValue('technical_application_description','');return;}
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getApplicationDetails');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',id);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==id){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  g_form.setValue('technical_application_description',r&&r.ok?(r.application.description||'Descrição não cadastrada para esta aplicação.'):'');
  g_form.hideFieldMsg('technical_application',true);
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_application',r&&r.message?r.message:'Não foi possível consultar a aplicação.','error',false);}
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>cd409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013118</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Aplicações - technical_mul</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_cd409647c3189f54e079b13ed4013118</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Aplicações/Sistemas afetados">a2309e07c3189f54e079b13ed4013170</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

function renderTechnicalOutages(){
 var multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.setDisplay('lab_technical_services',!multi);
 g_form.setDisplay('report_service',!multi);g_form.setDisplay('report_offering',!multi);
 if(multi){if(g_form.getValue('report_service')){g_form.clearValue('report_service');}if(g_form.getValue('report_offering')){g_form.clearValue('report_offering');}}
 g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service',false);g_form.setValue('outage_status_data','');
 g_form.hideFieldMsg('technical_multiple',true);
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application');if(!app){return;}
 var others=g_form.getValue('technical_additional'),service=g_form.getValue('report_service'),offering=g_form.getValue('report_offering');
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getStatus');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 ga.addParam('sysparm_multiple',multi?'yes':'no');ga.addParam('sysparm_additional',others);ga.addParam('sysparm_service',service);ga.addParam('sysparm_offering',offering);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('technical_additional')!==others||g_form.getValue('report_service')!==service||g_form.getValue('report_offering')!==offering||(g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes')!==multi){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_multiple','Consulta de ocorrências indisponível. Será refeita no envio.','info',false);return;}
  if(r.count){g_form.setValue('outage_status_data',JSON.stringify(r));g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service',true);}
  else{g_form.showFieldMsg('technical_multiple',r.message,'info',false);}
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>cd409647c3189f54e079b13ed401314f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Outages - technical_applic</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_cd409647c3189f54e079b13ed401314f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 13:51:13</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Negócio - Initialize</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() { renderBusinessIntake(false); loadBusinessOptions('report_service', 'getServices', ''); }
function renderBusinessIntake(checkOutages) {
    function yes(name) { return /^(true|1|yes)$/i.test(g_form.getValue(name)); }
    function field(name, visible, mandatory) {
        g_form.setMandatory(name, false);
        g_form.setDisplay(name, visible);
        g_form.setMandatory(name, visible && mandatory);
    }
    var serviceId = g_form.getValue('report_service');
    var offeringId = g_form.getValue('report_offering');
    var unknown = yes('offering_unknown');
    g_form.setMandatory('report_offering', false);
    g_form.setReadOnly('report_offering', !serviceId || unknown);
    g_form.setMandatory('report_offering', !!serviceId && !unknown);
    field('affected_function', g_form.getValue('report_extent') === 'partial', true);
    field('slow_action', g_form.getValue('report_symptom') === 'slow', true);
    field('report_frequency', /^(slow|error)$/.test(g_form.getValue('report_symptom')), true);
    field('error_message', g_form.getValue('report_symptom') === 'error', false);
    field('workaround_detail', g_form.getValue('report_continuity') === 'workaround', false);
    field('report_started_at', !yes('started_unknown'), true);
    field('classification_note', g_form.getValue('report_extent') === 'total' &&
        g_form.getValue('report_scope') === 'all' && g_form.getValue('report_continuity') === 'normal', true);
    if (!g_form.getValue('outage_status_data')) {
        g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service', false);
        g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_offering', false);
    }
    if (!checkOutages) { return; }
    g_form.setValue('outage_status_data', '');
    g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_service', false);
    g_form.setDisplay('outage_notice_offering', false);
    g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_service', true);
    g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_offering', true);
    if (!serviceId) { return; }
    // Sem oferta selecionada ainda, consulta somente o servico pai.
    var queryUnknown = unknown || !offeringId;
    var target = offeringId && !unknown ? 'report_offering' : 'report_service';
    g_form.showFieldMsg(target, 'Consultando ocorrências em curso...', 'info', false);
    var ga = new GlideAjax('LabBusinessIncidentAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getStatus');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_service', serviceId);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_offering', offeringId);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_unknown', queryUnknown ? 'true' : 'false');
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        if (g_form.getValue('report_service') !== serviceId || g_form.getValue('report_offering') !== offeringId || yes('offering_unknown') !== unknown) { return; }
        g_form.hideFieldMsg(target, true);
        var result;
        try { result = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) { result = null; }
        if (!result || !result.ok) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(target, 'Não foi possível consultar as ocorrências agora. A consulta será refeita no envio. ' +
                (result && result.message ? result.message : ''), 'info', false);
            return;
        }
        if (result.count) {
            g_form.setValue('outage_status_data', JSON.stringify(result));
            g_form.setDisplay(target === 'report_offering' ? 'outage_notice_offering' : 'outage_notice_service', true);
        } else {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(target, result.message, 'info', false);
        }
    });
}

function loadBusinessOptions(name, method, serviceId) {
    var previous = g_form.getValue(name);
    g_form.clearOptions(name);
    g_form.addOption(name, '', 'Carregando...');
    var ga = new GlideAjax('LabBusinessIncidentAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', method);
    if (serviceId) { ga.addParam('sysparm_service', serviceId); }
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        if (name === 'report_offering' && g_form.getValue('report_service') !== serviceId) { return; }
        var result;
        try { result = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) { result = null; }
        g_form.clearOptions(name);
        g_form.addOption(name, '', '-- Selecione --');
        if (!result || !result.ok) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(name, 'Não foi possível carregar as opções. Recarregue o formulário para tentar novamente.', 'error', false);
            return;
        }
        var validPrevious = false;
        for (var i = 0; i < result.options.length; i++) {
            g_form.addOption(name, result.options[i].value, result.options[i].label);
            if (result.options[i].value === previous) { validPrevious = true; }
        }
        if (validPrevious) { g_form.setValue(name, previous); }
        if (name === 'report_service' && g_form.getValue('report_service')) {
            loadBusinessOptions('report_offering', 'getOfferings', g_form.getValue('report_service'));
        }
        if (name === 'report_offering' && !result.options.length) {
            g_form.showFieldMsg(name, 'Não há ofertas operacionais cadastradas para este serviço. Marque Não sei identificar a oferta para continuar.', 'info', false);
        }
        renderBusinessIntake(true);
    });
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-08 13:16:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e47bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131b4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Negócio - Initialize</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_e47bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131b4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-08 13:16:16</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Serviços de negócio e ofertas">b66b10bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131c6</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Criar Incidente - Indisponibilidade de Aplicação/Sistema">66309e07c3189f54e079b13ed401314a</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:7630de07c3189f54e079b13ed4013139</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Técnico - Auto outage aplicação</name><order>110</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control,oldValue,newValue,isLoading){if(isLoading)return;g_form.clearValue('technical_outage_begin');refreshAutoOutage();}
function showAutoOutage(visible){
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_outage_begin',false);
 var fields=['technical_outage_notice','technical_outage_type','technical_outage_begin','technical_outage_hint'];
 for(var i=0;i<fields.length;i++){g_form.setDisplay(fields[i],visible);}
 g_form.setMandatory('technical_outage_begin',visible);
}
function refreshAutoOutage(){
 showAutoOutage(false);g_form.setValue('technical_outage_requested','false');g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','not_applicable');
 g_form.hideFieldMsg('report_extent',true);
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application'),extent=g_form.getValue('report_extent');
 if(!app||(extent!=='total'&&extent!=='partial')){return;}
 g_form.setValue('technical_outage_type',extent==='total'?'outage':'degradation');
 g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','checking');
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getAutoOutageState');ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('report_extent')!==extent){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','error');g_form.showFieldMsg('report_extent','Não foi possível verificar os outages da aplicação. Recarregue o formulário antes de enviar.','error',false);return;}
  if(r.hasExisting){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','existing');g_form.showFieldMsg('report_extent','Já existe outage ou degradação em curso para o SI principal. Nenhum novo outage será criado.','info',false);return;}
  if(!g_form.getValue('technical_outage_begin')){g_form.setValue('technical_outage_begin',r.now);}
  g_form.setValue('technical_outage_state','eligible');g_form.setValue('technical_outage_requested','true');showAutoOutage(true);
 });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 15:16:36</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ebc3a287c310df54e079b13ed4013196</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Auto outage aplicação</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_ebc3a287c310df54e079b13ed4013196</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 15:16:36</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Criar Incidente - Indisponibilidade de Aplicação/Sistema">66309e07c3189f54e079b13ed401314a</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:4b30de07c3189f54e079b13ed4013197</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>LAB Técnico - Filtrar vínculos 1</name><order>90</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control,oldValue,newValue,isLoading){if(isLoading)return;resetRelatedServices();}
function loadRelatedServices(name,method,serviceId){
 var app=g_form.getValue('technical_application'),multi=g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes';
 g_form.hideFieldMsg(name,true);g_form.clearOptions(name);g_form.addOption(name,'','-- Não informado --');g_form.setReadOnly(name,true);
 if(!app||multi||(name==='report_offering'&&!serviceId)){
  if(!app&&name==='report_service'){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,'Selecione a aplicação para consultar os serviços relacionados.','info',false);}
  return;
 }
 var ga=new GlideAjax('LabTechnicalIncidentAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name',method);ga.addParam('sysparm_application',app);
 if(serviceId){ga.addParam('sysparm_service',serviceId);}
 ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
  if(g_form.getValue('technical_application')!==app||g_form.getValue('technical_multiple')==='yes'||(name==='report_offering'&&g_form.getValue('report_service')!==serviceId)){return;}
  var r;try{r=JSON.parse(answer);}catch(e){}
  if(!r||!r.ok){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,'Não foi possível consultar os vínculos. Recarregue o formulário para tentar novamente.','error',false);return;}
  g_form.clearOptions(name);g_form.addOption(name,'','-- Não informado --');
  for(var i=0;i<r.options.length;i++){g_form.addOption(name,r.options[i].value,r.options[i].label);}
  g_form.setReadOnly(name,!r.options.length);
  if(!r.options.length){g_form.showFieldMsg(name,name==='report_service'?'Nenhum serviço operacional com oferta diretamente relacionada à aplicação selecionada. O preenchimento continua opcional.':'Nenhuma oferta operacional deste serviço está diretamente relacionada à aplicação selecionada.','info',false);}
 });
}
function resetRelatedServices(){
 g_form.clearValue('report_offering');g_form.clearValue('report_service');
 loadRelatedServices('report_offering','getOfferings','');loadRelatedServices('report_service','getServices','');
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-06 14:25:15</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ef081acfc3d89f54e079b13ed40131ce</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB Técnico - Filtrar vínculos 1</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_ef081acfc3d89f54e079b13ed40131ce</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-06 14:25:15</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.LabBusinessIncidentAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Ajax autenticado para o producer de serviços de negócio; reutiliza o núcleo LabIncidentIntakeService.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LabBusinessIncidentAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var LabBusinessIncidentAjax = Class.create();
LabBusinessIncidentAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getRecordVariableLabels: function () {
        if (gs.getUserName() === 'guest') { return JSON.stringify({ok:false}); }
        var incidentId = String(this.getParameter('sysparm_incident') || '');
        if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(incidentId)) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false}); }
        var incident = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');
        if (!incident.get(incidentId) || !incident.canRead()) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false}); }
        // Resolve somente valores salvos deste producer em um incidente legivel.
        // Nao aceita sys_ids de CIs arbitrarios fornecidos pelo navegador.
        var questions = new GlideRecord('item_option_new');
        questions.addQuery('variable_set', 'b66b10bbc3185f94e079b13ed40131c6');
        questions.addQuery('name', 'IN', 'report_service,report_offering');
        questions.query();
        var names = {}, ids = [];
        while (questions.next()) {
            var questionId = questions.getUniqueValue();
            ids.push(questionId);
            names[questionId] = questions.getValue('name');
        }
        if (!ids.length) { return JSON.stringify({ok:true,matched:false}); }
        var answers = new GlideRecord('question_answer');
        answers.addQuery('table_name', 'incident');
        answers.addQuery('table_sys_id', incidentId);
        answers.addQuery('question', 'IN', ids.join(','));
        answers.query();
        var result = {ok:true,matched:false,labels:{}};
        while (answers.next()) {
            result.matched = true;
            var name = names[answers.getValue('question')];
            var value = String(answers.getValue('value') || '');
            if (!name || !value) { continue; }
            var table = name === 'report_service' ? 'cmdb_ci_service' : 'service_offering';
            // Inclui registros inativos quando legiveis, sem ampliar ACLs da CMDB.
            var record = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
            var label = 'Registro removido ou sem acesso';
            if (/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(value) && record.get(value) && record.canRead() && record.getElement('name').canRead()) {
                label = String(record.getDisplayValue() || label);
            }
            result.labels[name] = {value:value,label:label};
        }
        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },
    getServices: function () {
        if (gs.getUserName() === 'guest') { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,message:'Faça login.'}); }
        return JSON.stringify(new global.LabIncidentIntakeService().listServices());
    },
    getOfferings: function () {
        if (gs.getUserName() === 'guest') { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,message:'Faça login.'}); }
        try { return JSON.stringify(new global.LabIncidentIntakeService().listOfferings(this.getParameter('sysparm_service'))); }
        catch (e) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,message:String(e.message || e)}); }
    },
    getStatus: function () {
        if (gs.getUserName() === 'guest') { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,message:'Faça login para consultar o status.'}); }
        try {
            var service = new global.LabIncidentIntakeService();
            return JSON.stringify(service.getStatus(this.getParameter('sysparm_service'),
                this.getParameter('sysparm_offering'), service._yes(this.getParameter('sysparm_unknown'))));
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('Intake status: ' + e + '; stack=' + e.stack + '; line=' + e.lineNumber, 'LabIncidentIntake');
            return JSON.stringify({ok:false,message:'Consulta temporariamente indisponível.'});
        }
    },
    isPublic: function () { return false; },
    type: 'LabBusinessIncidentAjax'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>diego.peukert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-08 13:16:14</sys_created_on><sys_id>087bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed4013195</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LabBusinessIncidentAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_087bd4bbc3185f94e079b13ed4013195</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>diego.peukert</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-08 13:16:14</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
